CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFSCHEDULE

The KoldFusion scheduler requests URLs on a timetable, for example to rebuild a report every night or to publish a dynamic page as a static HTML file. CFSCHEDULE lets a template manage these tasks; they are the same tasks you see on the Scheduled Tasks page of the Administrator.

Category

File, directory and system

Syntax

<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Update"
    TASK="taskname"
    OPERATION="HTTPRequest"
    URL="URL"
    STARTDATE="date"
    STARTTIME="time"
    INTERVAL="seconds"
    ENDDATE="date"
    ENDTIME="time"
    REQUESTTIMEOUT="seconds"
    USERNAME="username"
    PASSWORD="password"
    PROXYSERVER="hostname"
    PUBLISH="Yes/No"
    PATH="path_to_file"
    FILE="filename"
    RESOLVEURL="Yes/No">

<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Delete" TASK="taskname">
<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Run" TASK="taskname">

Attributes

ACTION
Required. Update creates the task or changes it; Delete removes it; Run starts it right away.
TASK
Required. Name of the task.
OPERATION
Required for Update. Must be HTTPRequest.
URL
Required for Update. The page to request. A URL that starts with / is requested from this server.
STARTDATE
Required for Update. Date of the first run.
STARTTIME
Required for Update. Time of the first run.
INTERVAL
Required for Update. Once, Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or a number of seconds between runs (at least 60).
ENDDATE
Optional. Last date the task runs.
ENDTIME
Optional. Time after which the task stops. With a number of seconds as INTERVAL, the task runs only between STARTTIME and ENDTIME each day.
REQUESTTIMEOUT
Optional, default "30". Seconds to wait for the page.
USERNAME
Optional. User name if the URL is protected.
PASSWORD
Optional. Password if the URL is protected. Stored scrambled.
PROXYSERVER
Optional. Proxy server for the request.
PUBLISH
Optional, default "No". Yes saves the page that comes back into PATH and FILE.
PATH
Required if PUBLISH is Yes. Directory for the published file.
FILE
Required if PUBLISH is Yes. Name of the published file.
RESOLVEURL
Optional. Stored with the task. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion does not rewrite links in published pages.

Usage

Tasks are kept in the registry under HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion\CurrentVersion\Schedule, one subkey per task. The scheduler looks for due tasks once a minute; Run starts the task in the background and returns immediately. Every run is written to schedule.log.

Deleting or running a task that does not exist throws an Application exception.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Create a task, look at what was stored, and delete it again --->
<CFSET Tomorrow = DateFormat(DateAdd("d", 1, Now()), "mm/dd/yyyy")>
<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Update" TASK="SnippetDemoTask" OPERATION="HTTPRequest"
            URL="/CFDOCS/index.cfm" STARTDATE="#Tomorrow#" STARTTIME="2:00 AM"
            INTERVAL="Daily" REQUESTTIMEOUT="60" PUBLISH="No">

<CFREGISTRY ACTION="GetAll" NAME="Stored" TYPE="String" SORT="Entry"
  BRANCH="HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Allair\KoldFusion\CurrentVersion\Schedule\SnippetDemoTask">
<P>The scheduler now knows this task:</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Setting</TH><TH>Value</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Stored">
<CFIF Len(Value)><TR><TD>#Entry#</TD><TD>#Value#</TD></TR></CFIF>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>

<CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Delete" TASK="SnippetDemoTask">
<CFTRY>
  <CFSCHEDULE ACTION="Delete" TASK="SnippetDemoTask">
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Application">
    <CFOUTPUT><P>Deleted. A second Delete says: <I>#CFCATCH.Detail#</I></P></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
